about: Kyr's capability audit against Orsino, one family of rules at a time. Each family answers the same seven questions. The counts are not written here: bin/handbook.ts reads them from the books (each family names the handbook sections that hold its entries) and renders doc/architecture/capability-audit.md and the matrix on the handbooks' landing page. Deficiencies are ranked by what fixing them unlocks.

families.title: Ancestries, callings, backgrounds and formations
families.orsino: 25 ancestries (racialModifier, occupationOptions, traits), 7 classes with classModifier gear, gold and proficiencies, 215 backgrounds, 16 party traits recognised from the company's make-up.
families.faithful: Ancestry and calling attribute modifiers, hit dice, weapon and armour proficiencies, class abilities, lineage traits, the 215 backgrounds' scores and gold, formations recognised when a company sets out and held for good.
families.adapted: Backgrounds are grouped into kinds whose meaning is Kyr's (a skill, gear, a contact who hears news). Specializations are chosen or drawn at creation. Skills are carried, not rolled.
families.dataOnly: 20 of Orsino's 25 ancestries (birdfolk, orc, halfling and the rest) and the formations that need them.
families.missing: Most ancestries; class starting gear and gold are Kyr's own; formations needing a non-playable ancestry are unreachable.
families.abstractions: Ancestries are data plus traits Kyr already executes, so the gap is translation through the registry, not mechanism. A trait's perks that read an environment, a weapon or a trigger already run.
families.browser: Company formation shows ancestry, calling, background and specialization with their modifiers and a formation preview. The handbook now explains each in full.

families.title: Character creation
families.orsino: CharacterRecord and the pc template: 3d6 attributes with racial and class modifiers, hit die plus positive Constitution, starting spells for casters, class gear and gold.
families.faithful: Hit points at level 1 (hit die plus positive Constitution modifier), NPC hit points above level 1, attribute modifiers, starting abilities, spell selection for a specialist caster.
families.adapted: Attribute rolls are seeded per companion so a company can be re-rolled deterministically; gear is the calling's list plus the background's.
families.dataOnly: Orsino's occupation options per ancestry beyond Kyr's playable callings.
families.missing: Nothing structural for the three playable ancestries and seven callings.
families.abstractions: None: creation uses only rules Kyr already runs; it widens as ancestries are translated.
families.browser: Forming a company reads top to bottom on a phone and side by side on a desktop; each choice shows what it changes.

families.title: Progression, feats and high levels
families.orsino: Experience to any level (50L³ + 150L² + 300L − 600), a quality point a level, a new spell for specialists, feats at 5, 10 and 15, an epic note at 20; spell levels to 9 as caster level rises.
families.faithful: The experience formula to level 10, quality points, specialist spells, feats at 5 and 10, the death save and THAC0 by level.
families.adapted: A level is taken at the next sheltered rest.
families.dataOnly: Levels 11 to 20 and every slot row past class level 10.
families.missing: Slot tables stop at class level 10, so spells of levels 6 to 9 are unreachable and no level past 10 exists. Feats at 15 cannot be reached. Of ten feats, three are not playable.
families.abstractions: Slot tables and thresholds that run to 20 as data; a test party at levels 1, 5, 10 and 15; a way to start a campaign with an experienced company.
families.browser: Advancement is announced and applied at rest; there is no view of what the next level brings.

families.title: Action timing, reactions, conditions, costs and targeting
families.orsino: Initiative each round, actions a turn, haste and slow, preparation (Charge), compelled moves, wound-up blows, reactions on being attacked, on an enemy's melee, attack, cast or charge, on combat start, on a status expiring, on healing and on a kill; random multi-target spells.
families.faithful: Initiative, THAC0 against descending armour class, criticals, evasion, saves with the three-successes rule, the death save, haste and slow, confusion, charm and domination, preparation and compelled moves, conditions that tick and lapse, recharge.
families.adapted: Wind-ups are shown to the company a turn ahead; fleeing is the whole company's.
families.dataOnly: Reactions to an enemy's action (onEnemyMelee, onEnemyAttack, onEnemyCharge, onOffensiveCasting), onExpire and onCombatStart, extra turns, reflection and spell turning.
families.missing: Random multi-target spells (magic missile, lightning bolt, cone of cold, meteor swarm, prismatic spray); reactions to what an enemy does; thirty-two statuses Kyr cannot apply (overwatch, braced, invisible, reflect, spellturn, timestop and others).
families.abstractions: A reaction is a condition's or trait's hook on an event another combatant causes, answered within that event; a random target set is a target kind with a count expression. Both are general and replayable from the seed.
families.browser: A fight shows whose turn it is, the order, wound-up blows and conditions. It does not show a reaction as it happens or why a creature chose its target.

families.title: Spells: traditions, slots, durations and unusual magic
families.orsino: 131 arcane and 154 divine spells across levels 0 to 9, schools and domains, slot tables, spell saves and durations, and spells that summon, cast other spells, choose an effect at random, resurrect, kill outright or shift planes.
families.faithful: Slots by spell level, preparation and readying at rest, cantrips, spell saves for half or none, school and domain access, durations in turns.
families.adapted: Preparing a different spell takes an hour.
families.dataOnly: None: every Orsino spell is catalogued and says whether it plays.
families.missing: Unreachable spells above level 5 and unplayable spells that summon, cast, randomize, resurrect, kill outright or planeshift.
families.abstractions: Entity creation with an owner and a lifetime (summon, create, dismiss); an effect that casts a named ability; a weighted random choice of effects drawn from the battle's seed; resurrection as a state change on a fallen creature.
families.browser: Each companion's sheet shows what is prepared today; a spell is cast from the fight's menu with its effect stated. The handbook lists every spell with whether it plays.

families.title: Summoning, transformation, domination, movement, divination and travel
families.orsino: Summon creatures by kind or generated template, polymorph and shapechange, charm and dominate, flee, teleport and planeshift, divination that reveals.
families.faithful: Charm and domination (allegiance changes and control), fleeing.
families.adapted: Summoning calls a catalogued species and it fights for the summoner until the fight ends.
families.dataOnly: Generated summons, polymorph, shapechange, teleport, planeshift, mind reading, truesight.
families.missing: Ownership and dismissal of summoned creatures; transformation; travel by magic; divination that answers a question about the world.
families.abstractions: One entity lifecycle for summon, create, transform and dismiss; travel as a world action whose destination must be known; divination as a world action that teaches a fact the company can then act on.
families.browser: Summoned creatures appear in the fight's order. Nothing yet presents a place reached by magic.

families.title: Creatures: families, special attacks, resistances, behaviour and difficulty
families.orsino: 10 monster classes (stat line, weapon, hide, up to three attacks a turn, worth, gold) × 40 types × 31 aspects × 8 ranks, 44 animals, 17 elementals, dragons by colour, golems by substance, 89 kinds of person by trade.
families.faithful: Resistances and vulnerabilities, natural weapons and hides, creature traits such as flying and formidable, experience by kind and level, the golem as Orsino composes it.
families.adapted: Most of Kyr's fourteen species roll their qualities instead of using Orsino's stat line.
families.dataOnly: Most monster types, every rank and aspect, 40 of 44 animals, every elemental and kind of person.
families.missing: Several attacks a turn; most of the bestiary; temperament and habitat are recorded but read by nothing in play, so creatures do not warn, bargain, retreat or pursue by their nature.
families.abstractions: Species composed from Orsino's monster template through the registry (OrsinoMonsters already reproduces it); attacks a turn as a species statistic; temperament as the rules by which an inhabitant answers intrusion.
families.browser: Foes are shown with their condition and wind-ups. The Monster Manual now describes every species and what is not yet held.

families.title: Equipment, treasure and magic items
families.orsino: 83 weapons, 15 armours, 68 pieces of gear, 48 magic items, 28 consumables, treasure tiers by depth.
families.faithful: Weapons and armour with proficiency, weight and the knight's perk; consumables that heal or harm.
families.adapted: Treasure is placed by authors and kits, not rolled by tier.
families.dataOnly: 60 of 68 gear, 42 of 48 magic items, 22 of 28 consumables, treasure tiers.
families.missing: Most magic items, including those that react when their bearer is attacked; item charges; treasure by tier.
families.abstractions: Items are mostly data over effects Kyr already runs; the reaction abstraction above unlocks the rest.
families.browser: Outfitting is a menu of what each companion carries; the handbook lists every item.

families.title: Environment, world and planar rules
families.orsino: Terrain and weather, light, traps with triggers and saves, wonders that grant, ten planes with alignment, terrain, domain and global effects applied to everyone resident.
families.faithful: Terrain perks (an elven tribe in a forest), searching by taking 10 against 15.
families.adapted: Time, light, weather, passages, obstacles, lodging, food, dominion and people are Kyr's own world rules, written in Kyr and listed in the guide.
families.dataOnly: All ten planes, all traps and wonders.
families.missing: Planes as places with laws; a law that changes magic or combat for everyone in a place; traps and wonders as generated content.
families.abstractions: A place's laws as modifiers every creature there holds while it is there (Orsino's residency passive), applied through the same condition machinery; travel between planes as a passage whose access is a condition.
families.browser: The map shows places and ways; nothing yet shows a place's laws.

families.title: Content authoring and generation
families.orsino: Deem tables and templates generate creatures, dungeons, rooms, settlements, shops and treasure; the books are generated from the same tables.
families.faithful: Deem as the generator; creature generation by family, terrain and adaptation; dragons by lineage and maturity.
families.adapted: Worlds are assembled from a region's geography and kits whose slots, proposals and provided facts are checked; every choice is recorded.
families.dataOnly: Dungeon and room generation, settlements and shops by size, traps, wonders.
families.missing: Institutions and planes as kits; a city; a layered situation web that spans levels of play.
families.abstractions: Kits that bring sites, institutions and planes with the facts they must preserve.
families.browser: Generated worlds play like authored ones.

deficiencies.title: Progression stops at level 10
deficiencies.unlocks: 56 spells of levels 6–9, feats at 15, levels 11–20

deficiencies.title: Creatures are fourteen hand-made species, one attack a turn, and their temperament is read by nothing
deficiencies.unlocks: Orsino's bestiary through the monster template; multi-attack; inhabitants that answer intrusion

deficiencies.title: Summoning has no ownership, lifetime or dismissal, and cannot call a generated creature
No reactions to what an enemy does
deficiencies.unlocks: 32 statuses (overwatch, braced, reflect, spellturn …), reactive magic items

deficiencies.title: No random multi-target spells
deficiencies.unlocks: magic missile, lightning bolt, cone of cold, meteor swarm, prismatic spray

deficiencies.title: No planes, place laws or magical travel
deficiencies.unlocks: 10 planes, planeshift, teleport, a planar adventure

deficiencies.title: Cast, random effect, resurrect and kill effects
deficiencies.unlocks: 20 entries that cast, 6 that randomize, 8 that resurrect or kill

deficiencies.title: Electric damage is not a Kyr damage kind
No city, no institutions as kits
